entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. Order number 774-29B-11.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me pull up that order... I see a VeloBand GPS Tracker delivered on December 15th. Is that correct?
Alright. And just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I just changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy and I really don't use it. I was about to just list it on some resale site but figured I'd try calling first.
I understand, and I'm glad you called us first. Let me just check the return eligibility for that order. One moment, please.

Okay, thanks for waiting. I've reviewed the policy. It looks like you received the item 38 days ago, and our policy allows for returns up to 10 days. So, you are definitely eligible for a full refund.
Huh. Surprising. I figured you'd have some rule against that.
Not at all, you're well within the timeframe. I'm generating a prepaid return label now and sending it to the email we have on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes.

Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be issued to your original payment method. It can take 3-5 business days to appear on your statement after that.
Whatever. As long as it shows up.
It certainly will. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
